- [LDET.6.2.3] Aggressive math optimisations (`-ffast-math`,
  `-funsafe-math-optimizations`) are **not permitted** for
  any arithmetic whose result affects observable output.
  These are the primary within-platform source of
  floating-point non-determinism (reassociation, denormal
  flushing, sin-cos fused approximations), and the spec
  forbids them outright.
